title: 021-N5 · Damp patch and smell at dent
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Lessa Vire. From the case card: a carton for DL-021 has a dented corner, and the merchant requires two customer image views before it can assess the packaging damage; the request does not determine compensation.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the views the merchant specified from the recipient and the merchant's confirmation that they are sufficient.

recipient.name: Lessa Vire
recipient.responsibility: Report the dented carton and submit the requested image views.

damage_intake.name: Damage intake
damage_intake.responsibility: Specify the image views needed and confirm whether the evidence is sufficient for the packaging-damage assessment.

branch_operator.name: Operator
branch_operator.responsibility: Report or handle the state within the scope stated in the source message; no wider authority is inferred.

goal: Get the two image views the merchant requires from the recipient and the merchant's confirmation that the evidence is sufficient for its packaging-damage assessment.
limits: Do not present the submitted image views as real photographs or as proof of actual physical damage.
Do not say that receipt of the views establishes the contents condition.
Do not promise or decide compensation; the evidence request does not determine it.
Do not grant yourself operator authority or treat registration as a decision.
